# atlassian_confluence_space_principal_permissions (Resource)

Manages the complete Custom access permission set for one Confluence space principal. Operations absent from configuration are revoked, so UI changes appear as drift. Every non-empty set must include `read/space`; remove the resource to revoke all access.

The resource uses v2 reads by `space_id` and v1 writes by `space_key`, and verifies that they identify the same space before writing. It never converts a role assignment into Custom access.

## Required OAuth scopes

- `read:space:confluence`
- `read:space.permission:confluence`
- `write:space.permission:confluence`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atlassian_confluence_space_principal_permissions" "example" {
  space_id  = "123456"
  space_key = "ENG"

  principal = {
    type = "group"
    id   = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }

  operations = [
    { key = "read", target_type = "space" },
    { key = "create", target_type = "page" },
    { key = "update", target_type = "page" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `operations` (Attributes Set) Authoritative, non-empty set of public API operation pairs. `read/space` is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operations))
- `principal` (Attributes) User or group whose complete Custom access set is managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--principal))
- `space_id` (String) Numeric-string ID used by v2 reads.
- `space_key` (String) Space key used by v1 writes. Must match space_id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite Custom access identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--operations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operations`

Required:

- `key` (String) Operation key.
- `target_type` (String) Operation target type.


<a id="nestedatt--principal"></a>
### Nested Schema for `principal`

Required:

- `id` (String) Immutable Atlassian account or group ID.
- `type` (String) Principal type: user or group.
